summary: Single O is a Botany (Sydney) specialty coffee roaster with cafes in Sydney, Brisbane and Tokyo. Serena Munroe has been Financial Controller since March 2020 and a Senior Commercial Finance Manager, Teresa Zhang, joined in June 2026. In August 2026 Single O advertised a part-time developer for its Shopify Plus and NetSuite platforms. NetSuite is the main risk for a Xero-oriented pitch.

hooks.text: August 2026 hire for the Shopify Plus and NetSuite platforms: systems are being rebuilt now, so reconciliation design is live.
Serena has overseen month end close at big-firm scale; wholesale/hospitality plus cafes across Sydney, Brisbane and Tokyo gives many feeds into close.
Finance team growing with Teresa Zhang's June 2026 arrival.

risks.text: NetSuite is in the stack (per a staff post), so a Xero-first message may not fit; mid-market ERP tooling may cover some reconciliation.
Strong finance leadership and a new commercial finance hire may reduce urgency.
